quotes: The desired Demon would be a Pit Lord from the Furnace of Pain, due to it being naturally Immune to most damage types other than Physical and Magic. This makes for tanky enough of a pet to survive Uber Tristram and the Colossal Ancients.

You also need to stack as much -xx% Enemy Resistance as possible without tanking the build's Resistances. Hellwarden's Will + Sling and a Sunder Charm with -xx% Enemy Magic Resistance more than doubles your damage output. Make sure to replace a Gheed's Fortune with more damage or survivability, if you're using one.
Prebuffing with Demon Limb and Treachery Breast Plate gives better Attack Rating and Survivability.

Act 5 Frenzy Mercenary with the full Sazabi's Set becomes incredibly tanky, and can survive the attacks of the Ancients with some Potion help. Shift Clicking your Potion number auto feeds them that potion. His main purpose is to apply Open Wounds with Malice Mythical Sword or Crushing Blow with more expensive runeword options. Make sure to prebuff him with Demon Limb and Treachery Breast Plate.
